column1: # The sources of the libraries linked into the bundled ffmpeg (FFMPEG_BUILD in build/versions.env), as BtbN's
# build scripts at FFMPEG_BUILDS_COMMIT name them (scripts.d/, one stage per script): every stage enabled for
# the linux64-gpl and win64-gpl builds of ffmpeg 7.1, with tags resolved to commits, plus what those stages'
# download steps fetch besides (shaderc's DEPS, opus' model data, rav1e's crates, submodules).
# `build/fetch.sh ffmpeg-libraries` fetches them all into one archive, which the release mirrors with ffmpeg's
# own source (see "Licences" in the README), and checks that the licence texts named below are what
# build/ffmpeg-licenses.txt holds; build/programs.sh checks that file has every row. On a new FFMPEG_BUILD, list
# path: the folder (or file) in the archive, named after the stage
# kind: git (ref is the commit; the commit id checks the content), svn (ref is the revision), file (ref is
#       the sha256), crates (every registry crate in the Cargo.lock at ref, checked against its checksum there)
# options: submodules (all, recursive), submodules=<path>, drop=<path> (a folder BtbN's download step deletes
#          before the build), snapshot=<url>#<sha256> (svn: a zip of that revision to use instead of svn, whose
#          files, hashed as `find . -type f | sort | xargs sha256sum | sha256sum`, give that sha256); - for none
# builds: the BtbN builds that link it
# licences: the files with its licence texts and notices, relative to path, separated by commas; file@A-B is
#           lines A to B of a file that has the notice in it; * for crates: each crate's own licence files (or
#           its Cargo.toml's license and authors when it has none); - for a file, covered by the folder it is in
